from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup layout
        title = "The First Layer: The Key Detectors"
        lines = [
            "The MLP consists of two main linear layers.",
            "The first layer acts as a set of \"Keys\".",
            "Each neuron in this layer detects a specific concept.",
            "When input matches a Key, the neuron activates strongly.",
            "This activation signals that a specific fact was found."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # Define common colors
        COLOR_KEYS = "#ADD8E6"  # Light Blue
        COLOR_INPUT = "#FFFFE0" # Light Yellow
        COLOR_PULSE = "#00FFFF" # Cyan
        COLOR_NEUTRAL = "#888888"

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        
        # Create Layer 1 (Keys) and Layer 2 (Values)
        layer1_neurons = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.2, color=COLOR_KEYS) for _ in range(5)])
        layer2_neurons = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.2, color=COLOR_NEUTRAL) for _ in range(5)])
        
        for i, row_char in enumerate(["B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]):
            self.place_at_grid(layer1_neurons[i], f"{row_char}3")
            self.place_at_grid(layer2_neurons[i], f"{row_char}5")
            
        connections = VGroup()
        for n1 in layer1_neurons:
            for n2 in layer2_neurons:
                line = Line(n1.get_right(), n2.get_left(), stroke_width=1, color=DARK_GRAY)
                connections.add(line)

        self.play(Create(layer1_neurons), Create(layer2_neurons), Create(connections), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].set_color(GRAY), self.lecture[1].set_color(COLOR_KEYS))
        
        keys_label = Text("Keys", font_size=24, color=COLOR_KEYS)
        self.place_at_grid(keys_label, "A3")
        
        self.play(Write(keys_label))
        self.play(layer1_neurons.animate.set_stroke(width=4), run_time=0.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].set_color(GRAY), self.lecture[2].set_color(COLOR_KEYS))
        
        target_neuron = layer1_neurons[2] # At D3
        concept_label = Text("French Landmarks", font_size=16, color=COLOR_KEYS)
        self.place_at_grid(concept_label, "D4", scale_factor=0.8) # Positioned near D3
        concept_label.shift(RIGHT * 0.5) # Fine tuning for readability

        self.play(Write(concept_label), target_neuron.animate.set_fill(COLOR_KEYS, opacity=0.3))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].set_color(GRAY), self.lecture[3].set_color(COLOR_INPUT))
        
        # Input Vector "Eiffel Tower"
        input_box = Rectangle(height=0.4, width=1.5, color=COLOR_INPUT, fill_opacity=0.2)
        input_text = Text("Eiffel Tower", font_size=16, color=COLOR_INPUT)
        input_vector = VGroup(input_box, input_text)
        self.place_at_grid(input_vector, "D1")
        
        # Animate movement to the target neuron
        self.play(FadeIn(input_vector))
        self.play(input_vector.animate.move_to(self.grid["D3"]), run_time=1.5)
        
        # Hit/Pulse
        pulse = Circle(radius=0.2, color=COLOR_PULSE).move_to(self.grid["D3"])
        self.play(
            pulse.animate.scale(3).set_stroke(opacity=0),
            target_neuron.animate.set_fill(COLOR_PULSE, opacity=0.8),
            run_time=0.8
        )
        self.remove(pulse)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[3].set_color(GRAY), self.lecture[4].set_color(COLOR_PULSE))
        
        # Show activation strength
        activation_arrow = Arrow(self.grid["D3"], self.grid["D5"], color=COLOR_PULSE, buff=0.2)
        self.play(GrowArrow(activation_arrow))
        
        # Final highlight
        self.play(Indicate(target_neuron, color=COLOR_PULSE, scale_factor=1.2))
        self.wait(2)
